name: sol_integrations_chainlink_ccip_6
description: Missing router address verification in Chainlink CCIP ccipReceive allowing message spoofing
question: The source file in `source` defines a ccipReceive function (implementing CCIPReceiver or handling CCIP messages) that processes incoming cross-chain messages without verifying that msg.sender equals the trusted CCIP router address, allowing any external address to spoof CCIP messages and compromise contract state or assets; this excludes implementations that check msg.sender against a stored/immutable router address or inherit from a base contract (e.g. CCIPReceiver) that already enforces this check.
criteria: ccipReceive(Client.Any2EVMMessage memory message) processes message.data or transfers tokens without checking msg.sender against a trusted router address
A function overriding _ccipReceive or ccipReceive omits any onlyRouter or require(msg.sender == i_router) style modifier before acting on message contents
The contract handles cross-chain messages and uses the router-provided sourceChainSelector or sender fields for authorization instead of validating that msg.sender is the actual CCIP router
